metadata.question: Did the water extent in the northern part of Lake Eyre increase between June 20, 2025 and September 15, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lake Eyre, northern part (approximately -28.5°S, 137.3°E) - Dates: June 20, 2025 and September 15, 2025 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for water detection (10m resolution), or Landsat 8/9 as fallback - Need to define northern part of Lake Eyre explicitly 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds to get clear water observations - Use water indices like NDWI or MNDWI to detect water extent - Calculate total water area for both dates 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Water area could be 0 (lake dried up) - this is a valid result - C1: No images found for either date - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked (heavy clouds) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare water extent: if Sept > June, answer A; else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define northern part of Lake Eyre const lakeEyreNorth = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[136.9, -28.2], [137.7, -28.2], [137.7, -28.8], [136.9, -28.8], [136.9, -28.2]] ]); const date1 = '2025-06-20'; const date2 = '2025-09-15'; // 2. Function to calculate water area function getWaterArea(startDate, endDate, geometry) { // Try Sentinel-2 let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images for ${startDate}: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { // Fallback to Landsat 9 col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const sizeLandsat = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat fallback: ${sizeLandsat}`); if (sizeLandsat === 0) return null; } // Get median composite const img = col.median(); // Calculate MNDWI for water detection let mndwi; if (col.first().bandNames().contains('B3').getInfo()) { // Sentinel-2: MNDWI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) mndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']); } else { // Landsat: MNDWI = (Green - SWIR1) / (Green + SWIR1) mndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']); } // Water mask (MNDWI > 0) const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0); // Count water pixels const stats = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels = stats.get(Object.keys(stats.getInfo())[0]); return waterPixels !== null ? waterPixels.getInfo() : null; } // 3. Calculate water extent for both dates const waterJune = getWaterArea(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(3, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo(), lakeEyreNorth); if (waterJune === null) { console.log("No data for June 2025."); console.log("C1"); return; } const waterSept = getWaterArea(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(3, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo(), lakeEyreNorth); if (waterSept === null) { console.log("No data for September 2025."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Validation console.log(`Water pixels June 2025: ${waterJune}`); console.log(`Water pixels Sept 2025: ${waterSept}`); if (waterJune === undefined || waterSept === undefined || isNaN(waterJune) || isNaN(waterSept)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Compare and answer if (waterSept > waterJune) { console.log("Water extent increased"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Water extent did not increase"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
